name: GV Electricals Ltd
tagline: Rs ~155 Cr just-IPO'd electrical-infrastructure O&M and metering services provider to DISCOMs with ~40 years of execution history, ~77% recurring revenue, a 3.5x order-book cover and FY26 PAT that more than doubled -- but it is a competitive-bid contracting business at the least-differentiated end of the grid chain
business_overview: GV Electricals provides operation & maintenance (O&M), electrical-infrastructure development and metering services to electricity distribution utilities across India, with ~40 years of execution history and some international work. Contracts are long-term maintenance / AMC / rate contracts and project work orders won mainly through competitive bidding. Client base also spans industrial plants, government departments, commercial buildings and data centres.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 156 Cr revenue / ~Rs 10.5 Cr PAT; PAT more than doubled YoY
ROE / ROCE described as strong; exact figures not disclosed in the sources reviewed
fundamentals_narrative: The attractive features are the ~77% recurring-revenue mix (better than a pure EPC contractor), the 3.5x order-book cover, modest leverage and a doubling of FY26 PAT indicating operating leverage. The limiting features are structural: revenue comes from competitive-bid utility contracts with no pricing power, working capital and DISCOM payment cycles are a permanent drag, and ~40 years of history has produced only a ~Rs 156 Cr revenue base -- growth has not compounded. It is a freshly listed micro-cap with no public track record and a low-quality (untrusted X) origination.

verdict_headline: An order-book-backed grid-O&M inflection at an early, high-risk stage -- return-magnitude label allowed only on the small-cap live-inflection carve-out; conviction Low-Medium, unconfirmed
verdict_reasoning: Live-theme match: priority-1 'Grid / transmission equipment' and 'Data-centre power & cooling' (power distribution, substation, O&M for data centres) -- an accelerating tailwind, which is why an early-stage contractor still earns the label.

Written exception (four_box score 2.0): un-ignorable recent evidence -- FY26 PAT more than doubled, a ~3.5x order-book cover, ~77% recurring revenue -- into a live grid-capex cycle justifies '10x-in-2-3-years' despite tam=weak and moat=no; conviction is capped at Medium and set Low-Medium 'unconfirmed' because it is competitive-bid contracting with DISCOM working-capital risk and no listed track record.

Not marked revisit_after_30d (conviction below Medium-High). Re-check after two quarters: order-book conversion, receivable days, and whether the data-centre O&M revenue is material or just marketing.
disclaimer: This is independent research for informational purposes only, not investment advice.

value_chain.theme: Grid / transmission equipment (transformers, HV switchgear, HVDC, CRGO, insulators)
value_chain.position: Services layer -- O&M, metering and electrical-infrastructure execution for DISCOM distribution networks (and some data-centre electrical O&M), downstream of equipment makers
value_chain.pricing_power: Low -- competitive-bid AMC / rate contracts; differentiation is execution reliability and incumbency, not price
value_chain.note: Recurring-heavy mix is a mild quality positive versus pure EPC, but this is still the commoditised services end of the grid value chain.

four_box.note: tailwind=yes (priority-1 grid modernisation + data-centre power O&M). tam=weak (utility O&M/metering is a competitive, thin-margin niche). moat=no (competitive bidding, no pricing power). valuation=weak (~15x on FY26 PAT, but micro-cap SME re-rating/de-rating risk and unverifiable returns ratios). Score 2.0 with a written un-ignorable-evidence exception -> return-magnitude label permitted, conviction capped at Medium.

quality_metrics.note: IPO-disclosure basis (BSE-SME, listed Aug-2026). ROCE 27.1%/23.9%/31.1% FY24/FY25/FY26; PAT more than doubled to Rs 10.5 Cr FY26 on Rs 156 Cr revenue. D/E ~0.49; net_debt_to_ebitda approximate (small base). No cash-flow statement in available disclosures - fcf_conversion unsourceable, but DISCOM O&M carries chronic receivable/payment-cycle drag. Competitive-bid contracting, so capex_efficiency neutral. track_record_na: only FY25-FY26 have both metrics verifiable (<3 years).
